svg.title: Return loss versus frequency for one-step and two-step L-network matches
svg.desc: Return loss against frequency for three low-pass L-network matches: 25 to 50 ohms at 900 MHz (Q = 1, very wide), 2 to 50 ohms at 915 MHz in one step (Q = 4.9, narrow) and 2 to 10 to 50 ohms in two steps (Q = 2 each, about three times wider). The 10 dB line marks the usable band.
svg.text: Lower Q, wider match: one-step vs two-step L-networks
Ideal parts, low-pass versions. Return loss is infinite at the design frequency; the plot is capped at 40 dB.
